objective: Recover Android Community Wall gallery launch failures without broad storage permissions and without mislabeling selected-video preparation failures as picker-launch failures.
productionBaselineEvidence: Observed source baseline main 63ccd4b58ff02ff3c1535a1e05d3097fa8323c61, Expo runtime 1.3.2 from app.config.js. Source baseline is NOT production deployment evidence. No published OTA or device verification is claimed.
chosenApproach: On Android only, try existing system ImagePicker first, then its legacy SAF-compatible picker; if both throw, use already installed DocumentPicker for supported photos only. Keep web user gesture and iOS permission behavior unchanged. Distinguish video prep from gallery-launch error while preserving selected photos.
selectionRationale: Narrow shared Wall picker fix covers photo and mixed gallery callers, avoids requesting blocked READ_MEDIA_* permissions, and does not accept unverified-duration video files from the emergency Files fallback.
alternativeApproaches: Request broad Android media permissions (rejected: unnecessary and harms privacy).
Use Files picker for videos without duration metadata (rejected: bypasses 30-minute Wall contract).
Replace image picker globally (rejected: cross-feature regression risk).
preserveBehaviors: Android native Photo Picker remains primary and mixed photo/video mode remains available.
Android Files recovery uses grant-scoped image selection and existing upload conversion, with no new broad media permissions.
Web gallery still opens synchronously from a tap; iOS permission prompts remain unchanged.
Photo cap, 1-video Wall limit and 30-minute video duration contract remain unchanged.
Existing Community/Connect/ad/navigation interfaces and runtime 1.3.2 remain unchanged.
acceptanceChecks: Review exact three source/test changes and this declaration only.
Run regression tests for web tap activation, Android fallback, MIME and video handling.
TypeScript check and applicable Wall/Navigation CI must pass on exact PR head.
Verify a staging Android OTA on existing runtime 1.3.2 before production release; owner actual-device check skipped by previous instruction.
No production OTA, Play/AAB, native build or Supabase changes from this PR.
